scoring_justification: Cannot recompute quantum chemistry calculations; using result-level compare (T0) with paper-reported gold values and tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold ionization potentials (IP1-IP4) and excitation energies (Delta_df, Delta_fd) from paper Tables I-VI.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Tables I-VI (Liu et al., Phys. Rev. A 58, 1103, 1998)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed from paper and aligned with reference solution's output CSV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published results of the study, the standard reference for reproducing this computational dataset.

outputs.description: Computed ionization potentials and excitation energies for the actinide series. The checker compares each (Element,Method,Property) row to the paper‑reported reference values (hidden gold) within per‑property tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The DV‑Xα calculations for Es and No are excluded as they are a minor diagnostic comparison not part of the core dataset.

steps.description: Compare each row's Value to gold within tolerance
